The rear quarter panel and bumper cover on the left side show crushed metal, a crcaked
lamp housing and scuffing that run in a line consistent with a vehicle turning across

impact as described. Nothing on the car suggests earlier collision work, and the
invoices submitted show no repeated charges for the same parts or tasks. The proposed

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
